description: This PHP class, `NationalityMenuConfigurator`, implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface and is responsible for configuring a menu item related to nationality within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It uses traits for module screen helper functionality and overrides the screen to 'nationality'.

classes.name: NationalityMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for nationality-related screens in the HRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'nationality' using a helper method and returns null.
